description: Allocatable reviewer membership. Health is not membership: a provider whose local install is healthy is still unusable unless it is carried in the allocating registry (u2giants/shared-db scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs REVIEWERS). This file is the ai-devops mirror of that membership so one command can answer 'can I use this reviewer right now'. It is a guard: never flip a provider to registered to make an allocation succeed.

claude.reason: Approval-gate reviewer; never reviews a Claude-orchestrated issue.

gemini.reason: Not carried in the allocating registry. Two prior live attempts failed: one produced no parseable verdict, and one produced a bare PASS with an empty report - a counterfeit approval. Re-entry requires a live run against a small already-merged change that returns a well-formed verdict line carrying the head SHA, plus a substantive report, recorded in a reviewed shared-db pull request.

glm.reason: Rotation reviewer (glm-5.3). The retired glm-5.2 label is a separate identity and receives no work.

qwen.reason: Un-retired by owner instruction 2026-09-04; gated only by its own live preflight qualification.
